newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Colonial appoints new finance chief.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Colonial appoints new finance chief.

text.p: Financial services group Colonial Ltd said on Friday it had appointed Tim Wade as chief financial officer, effective February 1.
Wade replaces Paul Batchelor who joins rival financial services group, The Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP).
Colonial Ltd preference shares listed on the Australian Stock Exchange late in 1996 with company's ordinary shares expected to be listed in second quarter of 1997.
The AMP said in December 1996 that it would seek to demutualise and list on the Australian Stock Exchange in mid-late 1998. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373 1800
